## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear and concise description of the problem, e.g. "The image is missing [...]".

## Describe the solution you'd like

What you want to happen (new distro/version, package, default, CI step, ...).

## Describe alternatives you've considered

Any workarounds or alternative approaches you've tried (e.g. a derived image).

## Additional context

Anything else, such as links, example Containerfiles or related issues.
